# nginx

## services.nginx.enable

Whether to enable nginx web server.

*Type:*
boolean

*Default:*

```nix
false
```

*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix)

## services.nginx.enableIPv6

Whether virtual hosts without `listen` or `listenAddresses` also
listen on IPv6, by adding `[::0]` to
`services.nginx.defaultListenAddresses`. Stands in for
NixOS’s `networking.enableIPv6`, which nix-darwin does not have.

*Type:*
boolean

*Default:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix)

## services.nginx.enableReload

## services.nginx.defaultListenAddresses

## services.nginx.recommendedProxySettings

Enable NixOS’ recommended proxy settings (timeouts, HTTP/1.1 keep-alive

boolean


## services.nginx.upstreams

Groups of servers usable as proxy_pass targets.

*Type:*
attribute set of (submodule)

*Default:*

```nix
{ }
```

*Example:*

```nix
{
  cache = {
    servers."garage-a.internal:3900" = { resolve = true; };
    servers."garage-b.internal:3900" = { resolve = true; backup = true; };
    extraConfig = "zone cache 1m;";
  };
}

```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix)

## services.nginx.virtualHosts.\<name>.listen

Explicit listen directives. If empty, derived from `listenAddresses`
(or `services.nginx.defaultListenAddresses`) and
forceSSL/addSSL/onlySSL.
With forceSSL, only the `ssl = true` entries are used for the main
server and the non-SSL entries for the HTTP redirect server.

*Type:*
list of (submodule)

*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix)

## services.nginx.virtualHosts.\<name>.listen.\*.addr

Listen address. IPv6 addresses must be enclosed in square
brackets; `unix:` socket paths are accepted. When null, nginx
listens on all IPv4 addresses only (`*:port`).

*Type:*
null or string

*Default:*

```nix
null
```

*Example:*

```nix
"127.0.0.1"
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix)

## services.nginx.virtualHosts.\<name>.listen.\*.extraParameters

Extra parameters appended to the listen directive.

*Type:*
list of string

*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix)

## services.nginx.virtualHosts.\<name>.listen.\*.port

Port to listen on. If null, nginx’s default applies (80 for
an address; unused for a `unix:` socket). At least one of
`addr` and `port` must be set.

*Type:*
null or 16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive)

*Default:*

```nix
null
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/services/nginx/default.nix)
